title: Align native admission documentation with unavailable submission recapture behavior
outcome: Documentation accurately distinguishes full SourceId checks at admission and owner capture from the existing Shared submission behavior when recapture is unavailable; any stronger submission contract is decided separately before implementation.
acceptance: The declared-native admission documentation and module header make no unconditional claim of full source pinning through submission when existing behavior can submit source_id=None.

A behavior-level assessment records the existing changed-source refusal and unavailable Shared recapture fallback, and any proposed change to that fallback has explicit contract scope rather than silently widening this documentation fix.
